# Pinned CI tooling.
#
# Every action in .github/workflows/ is SHA-pinned and the downloaded binaries
# are checksum-verified; these Python tools were the remaining floating
# dependency, resolved fresh on each run. Pinning them means a lint or coverage
# job can only change when this file changes - and Dependabot can see and bump
# them, which it cannot do for a bare `pip install <name>`.
#
# Bump deliberately: gcovr changes can move the coverage number, and pre-commit
# changes can reformat the tree.
gcovr==8.6
jsonschema==4.26.0
pre-commit==4.6.2
pytest==9.1.1
yamllint==1.38.0
